summary: Python 3, pip, virtual environment support, local static app runs, installation, updates, and diagnostics.

commons.summary: Python and pip common helpers for CLI availability, pip, venv, executable details, and module checks.

check.summary: Python and pip readiness command implementation.

install.summary: Python and pip installation command implementation.

run.summary: Python local static app run command implementation.

update.summary: Python and pip update command implementation.

check.summary: Checks Python 3, pip through python3 -m pip, standard development modules, and inline runtime execution.

options.--yes: Do not pause for the final acknowledgement prompt.
options.--verbose: Print Python executable, site, and pip configuration when available.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

expected_failure_when: pip is missing or unavailable through python3 -m pip.
One or more standard development modules are missing.

install.summary: Installs Python 3, pip, virtual environment support, headers, and build tooling with explicit prompts.

options.--dry-run: Print the detected install command path without executing it, even if Python and pip are already installed.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

supported_hosts.macos: Installs python through Homebrew; pip is provided by the Homebrew Python formula.
supported_hosts.debian_like_linux: Installs python3, python3-pip, python3-venv, python3-dev, and build-essential through apt.

run.summary: Starts a local Python static file server for a target directory and optionally opens it in a browser.

options.--host: Host interface for python3 -m http.server. Defaults to 127.0.0.1.
options.--open: Open http://<host>:<port> after the server starts.
options.--dry-run: Print server and browser commands without executing them.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

expected_failure_when: A blackhost Python server PID file already points to a running process for the requested port.

update.summary: Updates Python 3, pip, virtual environment support, headers, and build tooling with explicit prompts.

options.--dry-run: Print the detected update command path without executing it, even if Python and pip are not installed.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

supported_hosts.macos: Updates python through Homebrew; pip is provided by the Homebrew Python formula.
supported_hosts.debian_like_linux: Updates python3, python3-pip, python3-venv, python3-dev, and build-essential through apt.

notes: check is host-read-only and does not install or update Python or pip.
run starts a local background Python HTTP server process and prints its stop command.
install and update mutate the host and prompt unless --yes is provided.
install and update support --dry-run where detected host command paths are printed but not executed.
dry-run must not short-circuit just because Python and pip are already installed or currently missing.
pip is managed as part of the python package because it is Python-specific package management tooling.
